claims.statement: The ROK Army Chief of Staff was consulted before the 1952 Pusan martial-law decision.

supportingEvidence.speaker: Rhee
supportingEvidence.reported: He phoned General Lee, who agreed to the command arrangement.

contradictingEvidence.speaker: Van Fleet
contradictingEvidence.reported: He and the ROK Army Chief of Staff had not been informed or consulted in advance.

claims.note: Both accounts appear in one US diplomatic telegram. Consulted before which decision/order remains unclear. Seek ROK written orders and Lee's correspondence.
